title: Corrected cite carries the wrong volume/reporter/page (all_caps_name).
examples: LF-BB-0646 "IN RE MCDIVITT ESTATE, 425 N.W.2d 575 (Mich. Ct. App. 1988)" → In re McDivitt Estate, 169 Mich. App. 435 (Mich. Ct. App. 1988)

title: Case name uses "vs."/"v" instead of "v."
examples: LF-BB-0695 → Iowa Vs. Mark Thomas Hennings, 791 N.W.2d 828 (Iowa 2010)

title: Carried-forward cite-check family "page_mismatch" regressed or still wrong.
examples: BANK-VT-06 "Robertson v. Mylan Laboratories, Inc., 176 Vt. 359 (2004)" → not_in_corpus

title: Carried-forward cite-check family "bluebook_variant" regressed or still wrong.
examples: ANAT-A294 "Jolly v. Eli Lilly & Co., 44Cal. 3d 1103 (Cal. 1988)" → error

title: Carried-forward cite-check family "secondary_form" regressed or still wrong.
examples: BANK-FL-03 "State v. DiGuilio, 11 Fla. L. Weekly 339" → name_mismatch
